claims.claim_text: Total revenue of $11.3M in FY2025, up 5% YoY from $10.8M in FY2024, driven by service-related revenue and ECD product sales.
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.source_quote: Total revenue increased to approximately $11.3 million in 2025 from approximately $10.8 million in 2024, driven primarily by growth in service-related revenue and ECD product sales.

claims.claim_text: Going concern: $227.0M accumulated deficit, $33.8M net loss, $30.3M cash used in operating activities for FY2025; auditor (BPM LLP) issued substantial-doubt going-concern qualifier.
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.object_value: accumulated deficit $227.0M; cash $20.6M YE2025 dropping to $11.4M at Mar 31 2026 (Q1 2026 op cash use $11.6M)
claims.source_quote: The Company's recurring losses from operations and cash used in operations raise substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. ... Cash and cash equivalents on hand were $20.6 million as of December 31, 2025 ... accumulated deficit of $227.0 million.

claims.claim_text: Customer concentration: one client individually accounted for 19% of total revenue in 2025 (vs. zero >=10% clients in 2024); two clients accounted for 28% and 11% of accounts receivable at YE2025.
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.object_value: 1 client = 19% of revenue; 2 clients = 28%/11% of AR
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company had one client who individually accounted for 10% or more of the Company's total revenue, net (19%), compared with no clients who individually accounted for 10% of total revenue, net for the year ended December 31, 2024.

claims.claim_text: K7 ASR remains in development with commercial production not expected until late 2026 or early 2027; K7 contributed zero revenue in 2025.
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.object_value: K7 = pre-commercial; commercial production targeted late-2026/early-2027
claims.source_quote: The K7 ASR remains in development and did not contribute revenue in 2025. Engineering resources continued to be allocated toward mechanical design refinement, sensor integration, durability testing, and software integration. Commercial production is not expected until late 2026 or early 2027, subject to development milestones and supply chain readiness.

claims.claim_text: Total order backlog of approximately $3.1M as of March 24, 2026 ($0.6M ASR orders + $2.5M ECD orders).
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.source_quote: As of March 24, 2026, the Company had a total backlog of approximately $3.1 million, comprised of $0.6 million related to ASR orders and $2.5 million related to orders for ECDs.

claims.claim_text: Acquired Event Risk LLC (rebranded Knightscope Security Force) on February 27, 2026 for ~$18M total consideration ($5.0M cash + $1.1M debt repayment + 1,724,418 Class A shares + $4.0M deferred cash + contingent earn-outs).
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.object_value: Event Risk LLC for ~$18M; 10-Q records $7.7M goodwill + $15.5M customer-relationships intangible
claims.source_quote: On February 27, 2026, we completed the acquisition (the Event Risk Acquisition) of all the issued and outstanding membership interest of Event Risk LLC ... Goodwill of $7.7 million and a customer relationships intangible asset of $15.5 million were recorded as a result of the acquisition.

claims.claim_text: Knightscope holds robotics-related intellectual property supporting its autonomous security robot platform (K1H, K5, K7) including lidar, imaging systems, and AI-based detection.
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.source_quote: Each deployed ASR integrates light detection and ranging, imaging systems, and AI-based detection capabilities designed to enhance deterrence, situational awareness, and reporting.

claims.claim_text: ATM offering program: $42.8M net proceeds in FY2025 (6.88M shares issued); additional $9.0M in Q1 2026 (2.03M shares); $3.3M April 1 - May 8 2026 (969k shares). $18.3M remaining on shelf as of May 8, 2026 — heavy ongoing dilution.
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.object_value: Class A shares outstanding rose from 4.07M (YE2024) to 12.19M (YE2025), then to ~14.9M+ post-Q1-2026 and Event Risk share issuance
claims.source_quote: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company issued 6,877,113 shares of Class A Common Stock under the ATM offering program for net proceeds of approximately $42.8 million ... From January 1, 2026 through March 25, 2026 the Company issued 2,027,993 shares ... From April 1, 2026 through May 8, 2026 the Company issued 968,639 shares.

claims.claim_text: Federal contract claim: Knightscope serves government clients (commercial and government markets including municipal / private-security customers per cohort metadata).
claims.subject: Knightscope
claims.source_quote: We serve clients across commercial, government, healthcare, education, transportation, and residential markets.
